official: 品川区後期高齢者医療に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案

name: 公示送達を画面で閲覧できる方法を追加
summary: 現在、公示送達は書面を掲示して行います。この議案では、公示事項を定められた方法で不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にし、区の事務所にあるコンピューター画面で閲覧できる方法も選べるようにします。
changes: 公示事項を定められた方法で不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態に置く
公示事項を記載した書面の掲示に加え、区の事務所にあるコンピューター画面で閲覧できる方法を認める
who: 後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達の対象となる人
why: 地方税法の改正に合わせ、公示送達の方法を見直すためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds an option to view public notices on a screen
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Shinagawa City Ordinance on Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Currently, service by public notice is carried out by posting a written notice. This bill would make the information required to be publicly notified available for viewing by an unspecified number of people in a prescribed way, and would also allow people to view it on a computer screen at a ward office.
changes: Make the information required to be publicly notified available for viewing by an unspecified number of people in a prescribed way
Allow people to view the information on a computer screen at a ward office, in addition to posting a written notice containing it
who: People subject to service by public notice concerning medical care for older senior citizens
en.why: The ward says it is reviewing the methods of service by public notice to align with revisions to the Local Tax Act.
